verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents multiple autonomous background automation capabilities: Incident Workflows with configurable 'if-this-then-that' triggers that fire automatically on incident conditions, AI Orchestrations that auto-analyze events and recommend/apply noise-reduction rules, and PagerDuty Advance agents (SRE Agent, Shift Agent, Scribe Agent, Insights Agent) that autonomously troubleshoot, coordinate schedule changes, transcribe meetings, and surface insights without manual intervention. This directly matches the AI-native 'autonomous background automation' story with rich first-party documentation across many independent features. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of these newer agentic AI features actually running unattended in production (community evidence only covers older escalation/API complaints, not the agentic capabilities).
